label: Where the weapons of mass destruction are found, and who else was involved
description: A call for hidden things to be revealed about where weapons of mass destruction are being found in Iran and the capability to produce more, with intel coming from the Israeli government, the United States and some of it from Saudi Arabia, and certain other nations said to be involved. He asks for it to be exposed rather than stating that it will be, which is the weaker form.
aliases: Concerning where they're finding these weapons of mass destruction
certain nations that are involved in this

label: A warty toad comes out of the Atlantic and jumps into Washington
description: A massive toad covered in warts coming up out of the Atlantic and jumping into Washington, which he reads as corruption, tied to Nixon and Watergate because he sees Nixon's face, and connected to Kentucky. The Lord is said to add that the toad came up out of the water and is on land again. It restates the Watergate-scale scandal material with a location attached.
aliases: I saw a toad coming out of the the the out of the Atlantic
I saw Nixon's face and I saw a Watergate scandal again
the toad came up out of the water and he's on land again

label: Blood sacrifice worked against the president's mind from Cuba
description: A photograph of the president placed on an altar in Cuba, with chickens killed and their blood drained into bowls, and a figure with deer horns wrapped around his head dancing in a corner, working against the president's mind. Nothing observable is attached to it beyond the instruction to pray for his mind, so it can only fail if his mental state is the test.
aliases: he was doing blood sacrifices with chickens

label: The twelve tribes on a chart, each with a stone and a meaning
description: A chart of the twelve tribes of Israel with a stone for each, green, sapphire, red pinks and purple, where he is told what each colour represents, sapphire being a healing ministry and emerald something else. He is also told this is his doorway or portal and that he will start to use it a lot. Nothing outside his own ministry is claimed, so it can only be scored on whether that use follows.
aliases: This is your doorway. This is your portal
This is the tribe of 12 tribes of Judah

label: An Acts 2 church and greater glory on the underground church under persecution
description: An Acts chapter two church coming forth in greater works where great persecution comes, with a greater level of glory on the church in the Middle East and on the underground churches in Iran, Iraq, China and North Korea, quoting Romans 8:18 that present suffering is not worth comparing to the glory to be revealed. Growth under persecution is the historic pattern in each of those places, which is what sets the base rate.
aliases: An Acts chapter 2 church is coming forth in a greater greater work
a greater greater level of the glory coming on the church in the Middle East
